attempts.source:
(letrec ((beats?
         (lambda (a b)
           (or (and (equal? a "rock") (equal? b "scissors"))
               (and (equal? a "scissors") (equal? b "paper"))
               (and (equal? a "paper") (equal? b "rock")))))
        (valid?
         (lambda (r)
           (or (equal? r "rock")
               (equal? r "paper")
               (equal? r "scissors"))))
        (play
         (lambda (round wins losses ties note)
           (if (> round 3)
               (object (cons "status" "done")
                       (cons "wins" wins)
                       (cons "losses" losses)
                       (cons "ties" ties))
               (let ask-loop ((note-now note))
                 (let* ((res (effect "ask"
                               (object (cons "message"
                                             (string-append note-now
                                                            "Round "
                                                            (number->string round)
                                                            " of 3: choose rock, paper, or scissors."))
                                       (cons "suggestions"
                                             (array "rock" "paper" "scissors")))))
                        (action (field res "action")))
                   (if (equal? action "accept")
                       (let ((reply (field (field res "content") "reply")))
                         (if (valid? reply)
                             (let* ((cpu (effect "random"
                                           (object (cons "choices"
                                                         (array "rock" "paper" "scissors")))))
                                    (note2 (string-append "You played " reply
                                                          ", I played " cpu ". ")))
                               (if (equal? reply cpu)
                                   (play (+ round 1) wins losses (+ ties 1)
                                         (string-append note2 "Tie! "))
                                   (if (beats? reply cpu)
                                       (play (+ round 1) (+ wins 1) losses ties
                                             (string-append note2 "You win! "))
                                       (play (+ round 1) wins (+ losses 1) ties
                                             (string-append note2 "I win! ")))))
                             (ask-loop "Invalid reply. ")))
                       (object (cons "status" action))))))))
  (play 1 0 0 0 ""))

attempts.source:
(letrec
  ((stop? (lambda (r) (not (equal? (field r "action") "accept"))))
   (stop-result (lambda (r) (object (cons "status" (field r "action")))))
   (with-reply (lambda (r on-ok)
     (if (stop? r)
         (stop-result r)
         (on-ok (field (field r "content") "reply")))))
   (ask (lambda (msg)
     (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" msg)))))
   (ask-review (lambda (name color)
     (effect "ask"
       (object (cons "message"
                     (string-append "Current badge: name " name
                                    ", favorite color " color
                                    ". Choose done, change name, or change color."))
               (cons "suggestions" (array "done" "change name" "change color"))))))
   (review (lambda (name color)
     (with-reply (ask-review name color)
       (lambda (text)
         (if (equal? text "done")
             (object (cons "status" "done")
                     (cons "name" name)
                     (cons "color" color))
             (if (equal? text "change name")
                 (with-reply (ask "What name should be on the badge?")
                   (lambda (new-name) (review new-name color)))
                 (if (equal? text "change color")
                     (with-reply (ask "What is your new favorite color?")
                       (lambda (new-color) (review name new-color)))
                     (review name color)))))))))
  (with-reply (ask "What is your name?")
    (lambda (name)
      (with-reply (ask "What is your favorite color?")
        (lambda (color)
          (review name color))))))

(let-syntax
  ((with-reply
    (syntax-rules ()
      ((_ expr id body)
       (let ((r expr))
         (if (equal? (field r "action") "accept")
             (let ((id (field (field r "content") "reply")))
               body)
             (object (cons "status" (field r "action")))))))))
  (letrec
    ((ask-name
      (lambda ()
        (with-reply
         (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" "Hi! What is your name?")))
         name
         (ask-color name))))
     (ask-color
      (lambda (name)
        (with-reply
         (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" "What is your favorite color?")))
         color
         (review name color))))
     (review
      (lambda (name color)
        (with-reply
         (effect "ask"
                 (object
                  (cons "message"
                        (string-append "Name badge: " name
                                       " | Favorite color: " color
                                       ". Say done, change name, or change color."))
                  (cons "suggestions"
                        (array "done" "change name" "change color"))))
         choice
         (if (equal? choice "done")
             (object (cons "status" "done")
                     (cons "name" name)
                     (cons "color" color))
             (if (equal? choice "change name")
                 (with-reply
                  (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" "What would you like your name to be?")))
                  new-name
                  (review new-name color))
                 (if (equal? choice "change color")
                     (with-reply
                      (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" "What would you like your favorite color to be?")))
                      new-color
                      (review name new-color))
                     (review name color))))))))
    (ask-name)))
